key_insight: SeLATM improves topic modeling by generating and refining topics at the segment level with agentic feedback loops, yielding more human-readable topics while reducing LLM cost.
engineering_relevance: This is useful for large-scale industrial text analytics where analysts need high-quality topic discovery with lower compute and better scalability.
method: Generate topics from document segments instead of assigning topics to whole documents
Use agentic feedback loops to refine and improve topic quality
Reduce resource usage while preserving strong topic modeling performance
evidence_signal: Experiments on multiple datasets show that SeLATM significantly lowers LLM resource consumption compared with topic-assignment-based methods while maintaining superior performance.
watch_item: Segment-level processing and iterative refinement may add pipeline complexity and require careful tuning to balance cost savings and topic granularity.
paper_title: Segment-Level Agentic Topic Modeling for Improved Data Exploration and Resource Efficiency
